name: js-roman
instruction: Implement roman.js (CommonJS): module.exports = { toRoman, fromRoman }. toRoman(n) converts an integer 1..3999 to a CANONICAL roman numeral using the subtractive forms CM CD XC XL IX IV; anything outside 1..3999 or non-integer throws a RangeError. fromRoman(s) parses a roman numeral and throws an Error unless it is CANONICAL - that is, 'IIII', 'VV', 'IC' and 'XIX '-style variants that do not round-trip must be rejected, while 'XIX' and 'MCMXCIV' are accepted. Parsing is case-sensitive uppercase only.
